# Alpha.4 fixture matrix

| Fixture | Primary assertion |
|---|---|
| strict TypeScript library | routine private work remains minimal; shared typed structure can be projected |
| checked JavaScript | JSDoc/checkJs remains a first-class language mode |
| transpile-only TypeScript | transpilation is not reported as semantic type checking |
| public ESM package | package exports, declarations and clean consumers are consequential shape |
| dual ESM/CommonJS package | module-condition shape requires separate consumers |
| browser runtime-data boundary | static types do not replace runtime parsing or real-browser evidence |
| async abort/resource flow | resource, cancellation and cleanup ownership is material |
| OMP extension | exact host entry point and lifecycle form a touchpoint |
| harmless private divergence | delegated helper movement does not fail conformance |
| fixed export/schema divergence | exact fixed-decision divergence is material |
| invalid generic contract/slice | returns `BLOCKED`, never invented confidence |
| alpha.3 legacy profile | ordinary resolution remains valid and structure is `legacy-unprojected` under alpha.4 classification |
